core_obligations: Compare the local rings (proof lines 489-505): for a surjective etale morphism from a scheme and a point of the scheme mapping to a point of the space, the strict henselization of the local ring of the space at that point is obtained from the local ring of the chart; by the behaviour of normalized dualizing complexes under flat unramified extensions, a normalized dualizing complex on the chart pulls back to a normalized dualizing complex on that strict henselization, so the shift occurring in the definition of the dimension function agrees with the shift for the chart.

Transfer the dimension function (proof lines 505-515): consequently the dimension function of the chart associated to the pulled back dualizing complex equals the composite of the map from the chart to the space with the function defined in the statement.

Topological conclusion (proof lines 515-522): since specializations in the space lift to specializations in the chart and nontrivial specializations in the chart map to nontrivial specializations in the space, the defining properties of a dimension function transfer, so the function is a dimension function on the space.
proof_roadmap: Identify the shifts of the normalized dualizing complexes on strict henselizations.
Match the chart dimension function with the composite of the map to the space and the given function.
Use lifting of specializations to conclude that the function is a dimension function.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the function on the underlying topological space of a locally Noetherian quasi-separated algebraic space defined by the shift making the dualizing complex normalized at each point is a dimension function (statement lines 485-496). The proof (proof lines 497-522) compares the shifts on affine etale charts using the behaviour of normalized dualizing complexes under unramified extension, identifies the chart dimension function with the composite, and concludes by lifting specializations along the chart. H2: a complete two step reduction.
